title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS, Pure M1 Two-Level Capped (K=7, eta_bad=0.5%, pe=0.30) & ZERO-EA Det-m_boot, E[W(n)] < 2^113.676151317439 G1 units

claims.statement: For BLS12-381 G1 ECDLP with auxiliary powers (bls12-381-g1-ecdlp), on any supplied instance (n, A, T) with 1 <= n < r, A_i = [s^i mod r]P_0, and target T = A_1 = [s]P_0 in G_1 \ {infinity} (uniform 1 <= s < r; ignoring A_2..A_n with zero auxiliary-power accesses, constant work bound W(n) valid for all 1 <= n < r, scored at n = 2^20 = 1,048,576), under explicitly declared exploratory-v1 STNFS premises (H1, H2, H3, H-X, and Pure M1 Two-Level Capped H5-2lvl with ZERO Trial 0, K=7 conditionally-i.i.d. f_9-side q*p_rand_j internal retries in [2^14, 2^16) [4,740 live-counted ideals] at min_mu>=15, pe=0.30, eta_bad=0.5% conditional on M>=1, boot success, and reached-child selection, deterministic per-node adversarial work cap T_cap(b)=min(nat_wc, M_cap*W_good) with exact Markov p_mk=1/M_cap and post_cap_mult=16.0x, inductive closure phi<=0.015, and unconditional Boole ONLY over <=16 top-level ZERO-EA surv_b=1.0 deterministic-Lovasz m_boot=2592.0 boot children), the self-contained (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS algorithm transfers (P_0, T) to G_T via the public pairing e(., Q_0) and recovers the 64-hex scalar 1 <= s < r (verified via [s]P_0 = T) with cold-run success probability >= 0.39 and expected total classical work E[W(n)] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*10*(2^111.7121 + 2^66) < 2^113.676151317439 G1 target-group-operation units for all 1 <= n < r, in particular log2(W(2^20)) < 113.676151317439 (C = 2,000 baseline scalar ARMv8.0-A integer instructions; core rows in C_core = 20,000 = 10 G1 units, core 2^110.354223222551, unified aborting meter t_run = 2^123 core units giving deterministic pointwise cap < 2^126.3219282 G1 units).
